title: Admissions Process
summary: Applicants create a Ravenna account, complete the application, submit forms and transcripts, and then enroll if admitted.
details: The official application portal is Ravenna.
For domestic grade 9 applicants, the admissions process includes the HSPT.
The 2025 HSPT test dates listed on the official page are November 8, November 22, and December 13, 2025.
Domestic applicants for grades 7 and 8 submit transcripts, recommendations, and recent standardized testing results such as MCAS or MAP.
The admissions page says decisions for grade 9 are released on February 1 and middle school decisions are released on February 27.
source_note: Official Malden Catholic admissions process page checked March 23, 2026.

title: Admissions FAQ
summary: The FAQ covers devices, uniforms, financial aid, transportation, lunch, languages, support services, and the school day.
details: High school students are required to bring their own Windows 11 laptop.
Middle school students do not need a device during school hours, though access to an internet-connected device at home is recommended.
The FAQ says school hours are 8:00 AM to 2:20 PM.
The FAQ says Latin, Spanish, and Italian are offered.
Financial aid and FACTS payment plans are available according to the FAQ.
source_note: Official Malden Catholic FAQ page checked March 23, 2026.

title: Transportation
summary: Malden Catholic lists bus routes, MBTA directions, and MBTA M7/S-card information on the transportation page.
details: Malden Catholic says it runs 3 bus routes serving Wilmington, Woburn, Medford, Peabody, Lynnfield, Wakefield, East Boston, North End, and Charlestown.
The page directs families to MBTA route information and describes walking directions from nearby bus stops.
The transportation page says MBTA M7 and S-cards can be requested through the school.
The page says M7 cards require payment in full of $300 for the school year before a card can be issued.

contacts.name: Mrs. Marianna Cavuoto
contacts.role: M7 and S-card contact for families outside Boston

source_note: Official Malden Catholic transportation page checked March 23, 2026.

title: New Student Onboarding
summary: The onboarding page covers spring orientation, MC Experience, uniforms, and how to contact the organizer.
details: The page lists Spring Orientation for girls on April 7 at 6 PM and boys on April 14 at 6 PM.
The MC Experience is listed for August 12 to August 14 from 8:30 AM to 12 PM.
The page says students should be in school uniforms for the first two days of MC Experience.
Students do not need laptops until Freshman Orientation according to the page.
source_note: Official Malden Catholic onboarding page checked March 23, 2026.

title: School & College Counseling
summary: The counseling page explains academic, personal, and college counseling support plus resources like transcript forms.
details: The counseling department provides individual and group guidance, parent and faculty consultation, and coordination of services.
The page says college visit schedules are available through the School and College Counseling office.
Current seniors can access a transcript release form from the counseling page.
The page highlights college and financial aid resources including Naviance, FAFSA, and the Common Application.
source_note: Official Malden Catholic counseling page checked March 23, 2026.

title: Athletics Calendar
summary: The athletics calendar page points students and families to upcoming games and the BigTeams calendar.
details: The athletics page says families can stay up to date with upcoming games on the athletics calendar and on BigTeams.
The BigTeams calendar link is included on the official page.
source_note: Official Malden Catholic athletics calendar page checked March 23, 2026.

title: Main School Links
summary: The Malden Catholic site header includes quick access links for the calendar, applying, inquiring, Lancerlink, and the parent portal.
details: The main website navigation includes Calendar, Apply, Inquire, Lancerlink, and Parent Portal links.
If someone needs the official website home page, send them to the main Malden Catholic site.
source_note: Main Malden Catholic website checked March 23, 2026.
